==Dialogue==
''Ahai, <Character name>. I am Bendah. My Sunspear duties are to map the underground caverns, caves, and passages running beneath Istan. You could say I've never spelunked a cave I didn't like. Ha! *cough* Anyway, corsairs are known to use these passages for smuggling loot and arms, so by surveying these illicit shafts I'm making Istan safer for us all.''
